name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Franklin KY

fieldNotes.truckGate: Guarded checkpoint ~250m south of the public road on the dedicated DC drive: a multi-lane gate canopy spans the truck lanes with trailers queued at it (z18/z19 sat).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small square guard booth on a curbed median island splitting inbound/outbound lanes at the canopy (z20 sat).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: ~2 inbound lanes under the canopy; exact split from overhead is approximate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron plus a large landscaped median and loop drive give ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron between the gate canopy and the building's north end where trucks queue before docks.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors with trailers backed in run along BOTH long faces (west and east) of the building, consistent with separate shipping/receiving banks; medium confidence which face is which.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock with trailers backed in along both ~1000ft+ long faces; total well into 50+ band (est. ~120).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated marked trailer-parking lots wrap the west, south, and east of the building, holding 100+ drop trailers (z19 south yard).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Franklin KY industrial park surrounded by farmland and open fields (Street View confirms big-sky rural setting); a few neighboring industrial buildings but broader setting is rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Industrial park on the edge of Franklin with cell towers visible near the entrance; coverage likely adequate, so false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Best ground pano on arrival is on the access road at 36.71094,-86.51195 (captured 2026-03); headings aim it toward the gate (241) and toward the property/building (198).
